This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.128/2024, dated 22.06.2024 registered at Police Station - Siddikganj District - Sehore (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 376 AB, 506 of IPC and Section 5(m)/6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 22.06.2024.
